Description: SWE-bench Verified evaluates software engineering agents by asking them to produce patches that fix real issues in open-source Python repositories, with correctness judged by running the project’s tests. The “Verified” subset focuses on tasks that have been validated as solvable and reliably testable, improving score trustworthiness and comparability across models.
Cognitive Functions:
L1: Language Comprehension (minor), Language Production (minor)
L2: Logical Reasoning, Planning, Working Memory, Adaptive Error Correction (minor)
L3:

Description: SWE-bench Multilingual extends SWE-bench-style patch generation beyond Python to multiple programming languages, testing whether agents can understand, modify, and validate code across diverse ecosystems. It emphasizes cross-language transfer, repository navigation, and robust debugging under differing toolchains and conventions.
Cognitive Functions:
L1: Language Comprehension (minor), Language Production (minor)
L2: Logical Reasoning, Planning, Working Memory
L3: Cognitive Flexibility

Description: SWE-bench Pro is a larger and more difficult software engineering benchmark designed to be more industrially relevant and more resistant to contamination than earlier SWE-bench variants. Cognitive Functions:
L1: 
L2: Logical Reasoning, Planning, Decision-making, Working Memory, Adaptive Error Correction (minor)
L3: Cognitive Flexibility (minor)

Cognitive Functions:
L1: Language Comprehension (minor)
